finding: Assumption Register links directly to source_ids although the governing traceability chain requires SOURCE → EVIDENCE → ASSUMPTION.
recommended_action: Add evidence_ids to assumptions and use evidence claims as the decision basis; retain source_ids only as optional convenience.
verification_method: Schema inspection plus sample trace from ASM to EVD

finding: Evidence records lack an exact source locator, so a claim can point to a document/site without identifying page, section, timestamp or exact help article location.
recommended_action: Add source_locator and claim_type to Evidence Register; add source publication/version fields to Source Register.
verification_method: Sample 10 evidence records and reproduce source location in two lookups

finding: Contradiction Register points to raw source IDs rather than the conflicting evidence claims, making it unclear exactly which assertions conflict.
recommended_action: Add evidence_a_id and evidence_b_id and require contradictions to be claim-to-claim.
verification_method: Trace CON-0001 to two explicit EVD records

finding: Source verification statuses and terminology statuses are used but not defined in the P1.0 control specification.
recommended_action: Define Source and Terminology status vocabularies explicitly.

finding: Requirement Register uses SPINE_CONSTRAINT although the roadmap scope vocabulary is SPINE/THIN/INTERFACE-ONLY/OUT, leaving cross-cutting requirements semantically undefined.
recommended_action: Define CROSS-CUTTING as a requirement scope or separate product-area classification from requirement scope; normalize current rows.
verification_method: Vocabulary comparison and sample requirement audit

finding: A bootstrap evidence.csv reused EVD-0005 through EVD-0014 for claims different from the complete retro-file register, creating duplicate evidence IDs.
recommended_action: Remove the duplicate bootstrap register; preserve the complete EVD-0001 through EVD-0178 range as canonical; update the research index.
verification_method: Verify duplicate file deleted and canonical index points to ID-range files
